en:
A RIZAP membership...
What should I do?

I'll join.
Training like this is too good to resist.

Ah, thank you very much!
I'll process your membership right away!

(I don't have enough money...
Maybe I should come back later.)
Sorry, but I think I'll pass.

I see.
That's quite a shame...

Please come back if you change your mind, though.
We'll welcome you with open arms!
Great. Looking forward to it.

(I should talk to the RIZAP trainer
again if I want to join.)

Welcome, sir.
How can I help you today?

I'm looking to join RIZAP.
Is that all right?

Ah, but of course!
I'll process your membership right away!

Actually, I don't need anything right now.
Sorry to bother you.

Understood.
Just let me know if you want to bulk up!

Thank you again for joining us!
In case you forgot, I'm your trainer, Makuta.

Right. Looking forward to starting up.
Give me everything you've got, okay?

But of course!
Don't forget, I'm the best trainer in town!

Your muscles'll slice through diamonds
once I'm through with you!
Y-Yeah... Nice.

Now then, let me explain
just how you train here!

Whenever you're in the mood,
come talk to me here at RIZAP HQ.

Then once you pick your routine of choice,
the sweat will start flowing!

Ah, by the way, one session will
consist of two separate training routines.

Got it. So when I want to train,
I just drop by and talk to you?

That's right! Don't forget, there'll be
dietary advice after each session as well.

But we can talk about that when we come to it.
I think I've crammed enough info in here already.
Now then, let's get sweating!

Kiryu-san!
Are you ready to start training?
Yeah, let's do it.
To the training room, then!

Tell me, Kiryu-san.
What routine would you like to do?
Let's go with this.

Perfect!
To the training room!
Nah, not right now.

Understood. Please come back
when you're in the mood!

Tell me, Kiryu-san!
Which routine comes next?
This one looks good.

Perfect!
Just give me a second to set up!

All right, that's it for today's session!
Now let's see how you did...

That was perfect, Kiryu-san!
You must be in excellent shape!

You did a great job!
No slacking though<symbol=em_dash_with_outline>try even harder next time!

Things really didn't go so well, huh?
Relax, recharge, and try harder next time!
Next, let's talk about your diet!

Kiryu-san, you should eat whatever
you think is the healthiest option.

Oh, but be sure to take photos of your food!
And don't forget to send them to me.

Only then will I be able to assess whether
or not your diet is on the right track.
<font_kind=yakuza_italic>I</font_kind> have to decide?

I thought you'd be the one telling me
what I'm supposed to eat.
I certainly <font_kind=yakuza_italic>could</font_kind> do that.

But if you don't form the right eating habits now,
RIZAP's training will never help you slim down.

As your trainer and mentor,
it's vital that I guide you toward a healthy future.
Huh. You're actually pretty legit.

Didn't I tell you?
I'm the best trainer in town!

Although, I imagine most people don't
have a grasp on what the healthiest options are.

That's why I'll be dropping hints for you.
Follow them carefully to boost your training to the max!
All right, then. Sounds good.

Now then, let's talk about your diet!
Your recommendation for today is...

I'll also text my hints to the number you
provided upon registering as a RIZAP member.

Farewell, Kiryu-san!
You can do it!

What's up, Kiryu-san?
You should be out eating!
Please come see me once you're finished.

Welcome back, Kiryu-san!
Let's see how that meal of yours was...

Now then, let's see how this round
of the RIZAP Challenge turned out.

That was fantastic, Kiryu-san!
Both your diet and training were flawless!

Your training was absolutely perfect,
and your meal was well-balanced, too!

Your training was absolutely perfect,
but watch what you eat next time!

Your training was absolutely perfect,
but, uh... your diet leaves a lot to be desired.

I can't complain much about your diet!
Your training was pretty good, too.

It turned out pretty good overall!
Give it 110% next time, though!

Your training was really impressive,
but your diet could use a little work.

Your training was definitely good,
but watch what you eat next time!

Your diet was wonderful! Now just tighten up
your training and you'll be all set!

Your diet turned out great!
Now just put some more effort into training...

You should try a little harder during training!
And maybe in your diet as well...

You have issues on both sides of things...
but with my help, we'll hammer them out in no time!

Now then, that brings our first round
of the RIZAP Challenge to an end!

How do you feel, Kiryu-san?
Is RIZAP everything you hoped it would be?

Let me see...
I guess I <font_kind=yakuza_italic>do</font_kind> feel a little more toned.

That's great news!
You're one step closer to that diamond-cutting body!

But it's important to rest as well.
You should hold off a while until your next session.

All right, I'll come back later.
Let's keep this going strong.

Of course! With my help,
you'll have the finest body in all of Kamurocho!

We're committed to results, after all.
That's RIZAP's mission statement!

Committed to results, huh? I can tell.
I hope it makes a difference.

As do I!
Well, keep up the hard work!

(I should hold off on training until
I see my results from the last session.)

Welcome back, Kiryu-san!
Are you looking to train today?
Excellent!

I see.
Please come again if you have the time!

Oh yeah, this was a great session!
Let's aim even higher next time!

That concludes today's RIZAP Challenge.
Nicely done!

Wow, Kiryu-san!
You've done every single RIZAP Challenge!
Huh. So that was the last one?

Yes, the 12th and final challenge is complete!
Now let's see how far you've come!
So what did you think of RIZAP?

I'm glad I decided to join.
I didn't expect such a personal touch.

I learned a lot about my diet, too.
You weren't kidding about being committed to results.

It's nice to hear such high praise!
More importantly, today marks your RIZAP graduation!

However, Kiryu-san! You can re-enroll
as a member whenever you'd like.

Come talk to me if you're feeling out of shape!
We can start from the very beginning again!
Hopefully it doesn't come to that...
Don't be a stranger, Kiryu-san!

Ah, Kiryu-san! Are you looking
to re-enroll in the RIZAP program?
I am...

I'm feeling kinda rusty, to be honest.
Get me back on the plan.

A wonderful decision!
I'll process your membership right away!

Please talk to me when you want to train!
I'll help you get the body you've always dreamed of!

Actually, I was just checking in.
Sorry to bother you.

It's no problem.
Just come again if you ever want to train!

Hold the freakin' phone!
Is that you, Kiryu-san!?

Wowee! It really <font_kind=yakuza_italic>is</font_kind> you!
It's been ages, man!

C'mon, bro!
You can't have forgotten <font_kind=yakuza_italic>me</font_kind>!

It's me, Sodachi! So, da, chi!
Y'know, the head honcho of the Sodachi Dojo!
Sodachi? Sodachi...
<font_kind=yakuza_italic>Yeah</font_kind>!?
I have no idea who you are.

God, you're the worst! Don't you remember
our epic flurry of fists back at the arena?

It <font_kind=yakuza_italic>was</font_kind> just one time, though.
Can't really blame you for forgetting...
Sorry, I wish I remembered.

No worries!
I just gotta give you a little reminder!

Folks 'round here call me Yasuo Sodachi.
I used to head up the Sodachi Dojo.

I was real close to your friend
Saejima-san back in the good ol' days.

Oh, you know Saejima?
Let's start over. It's good to meet you.

I'm not surprised you ran a dojo.
Those muscles are incredible.

Ain't they the best?
But y'know, I actually closed the dojo down.

I still miss the ol' stomping grounds...
I've got tons of memories of Saejima-san there.

That's too bad.
Did... something happen to make you close?

Oh not at all, unless you count the surging
land prices! It was high time to sell, baby!

I wasn't keen on doing it, but at that price?
Sometimes you gotta make sacrifices.

And now thanks to a little investment I made
here at RIZAP, I've got this killer bod!
They really <font_kind=yakuza_italic>are</font_kind> good at getting results!

Wait, you got stronger <font_kind=yakuza_italic>here</font_kind> of all places?
Wouldn't running a dojo keep you in shape?

Not at all! I might've been the master,
but I was kind of a piss-poor fighter.

I gotta say though, I made the right call.
This gym's way better than our dingy dojo.

And look what it did to my body!
I'm the shining example of buffness!
Right. Well, I've gotta go.

But Kiryu-san! Listen to me!
G-G-Get your ass back here!
Huh? What do you want?

So scary...!
C'mon Sodachi, you can do this... And go!

Hey there, Kiryu-san! Wait... <font_kind=yakuza_italic>Kiryu</font_kind>!
Please... Er, I wanna lock fists with you!

You want a fight?
With me?

Damn skippy! I've looked up to strong dudes
like you and Saejima-san my whole life!

I wanna get as strong as you guys someday...
Then beat you! That's my dream.

I'd given up on that dream for years...
But things're different now that I'm a beefcake!

My power's outta control compared to my past self!
I'm really itching to put it to the test.

I've gotta see how close I am to
the one and only Kazuma Kiryu!

Hey, wait up!
Don't leave!

What a pain in the ass.
I'm sorry, but I don't have time for this.

Whatever, man!
In that case, I'll have to make the first move!

No freaking way...
I don't stand a chance against <font_kind=yakuza_italic>you</font_kind>.

You're strong, but your footwork needs practice.
Right now you're just wasting your strength.

I know... My dojo training's made me
well-versed in all that technical stuff.

But... even though I know what to do,
my body just ain't quick enough to do it.
Some pickle this is...

You should keep practicing.
Experience is the only way to improve.

Yeah, you're right...
Ah, I've got it!

Kiryu-san! I'm gonna practice extra hard
so I can make use of these sweet muscles!

And once I'm done, we're gonna tussle again!
I hope you're ready for more!

Yeah...
Wait, what? We're gonna fight <font_kind=yakuza_italic>again</font_kind>?

Of course we are! Beating you's the only way
to prove I've got the fighting skills to fighting thrill!

If I can do that, and show the world
the hurt I'm packing...

I'll be able to make a super dojo
and get stupidly rich!
I'm gonna make it rain on these Kamurocho civvies!

Anyways, I'll be training till next time!
Seeya later, Kiryu-san!

What a mess.
How do I always get wrapped up in this stuff...?

I've tightened up my stance a bit!
How 'bout we go another round?

I'm really starting to get good!
How 'bout we go another round?

My body's never been this pumped up!
How 'bout we go another round?
I can't right now.

Huh? C'mon, man!
Anyway, lemme know if you change your mind!

Ah, Kiryu-san!
Do you feel like fighting me now?
Yeah, I'll take you on.

Sweet!
Thanks a ton!

Now, then...
Dieee, Kiryuuu!
Dammittt... I lost again.

You're definitely stronger than last time, though.
That's progress.

You mean it!? All right, then!
This isn't the last you see of me!

No way... I beat Kiryu-san!
I really did it! Yay!

I underestimated you.
Turns out you're pretty tough.

No way were you in tip-top form today,
but it doesn't matter. A win's a win in my book!

And as the winner of our match,
let me say one thing, Kiryu-san.
Your luck ran out today!

Make sure you're pumped up next time, okay?
Bye now!

Dammit, I should never have underestimated him.
How embarrassing...
It's from Sodachi.
How did he get my contact info...?

Whatever. I'll head over to the park
and humor him when I have some time.

Yo, Kiryu-san!
Thanks for coming all the way out here!

It's nothing.
Well? What do you want?

Hold up, man!
Didn't you read my freakin' email!?

Today's the day we settle this.
Just me... and you.

Well, thanks to all my training at RIZAP,
I've finally unlocked my true potential.

Anything I imagine, I can make into reality.
This is, so to speak, my final form!

So today, I'm gonna whoop you, Kiryu-san!
The world's gonna see how tough I am!

Nobody'll be able to deny my ability once
I've taken down the toughest dude in the world!

My new gym's gonna skyrocket to the top!
Oh, and I'll make fat stacks off my fighting book, too!

Some plan you have there.
I'd rather you didn't use my name, though.
